description: Create the complete HTML structure (all 12 sections with exact specified text) and full CSS styling (theme tokens, responsive mobile-first layout, decorative SVG dividers, typography, section styling, animation keyframes). This produces a fully viewable, beautifully styled static page. No JavaScript yet — animations defined in CSS but triggered later by JS adding classes.

The <body> should contain a loading overlay div (#loader), a fixed music-toggle button, and a <main> element wrapping all 12 sections.

Step 14 — CSS: Create css/styles.css. Start with CSS custom properties on :root — --color-gold: #c9a84c; --color-gold-light: #d4b85a; --color-maroon: #8b1a1a; --color-burgundy: #6b1515; --color-cream: #fdf6e3; --color-ivory: #faf3e0; --color-text: #3d2b1f; --color-text-light: #6b5b4f; --color-white: #fff; --font-display: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif; --font-body: 'Cormorant Garamond', Garamond, serif; --transition-smooth: 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); --section-padding: clamp(3rem, 8vw, 6rem) clamp(1rem, 5vw, 3rem).

Step 15 — CSS: Global reset and base styles. box-sizing: border-box globally. body: font-family var(--font-body), color var(--color-text), background var(--color-cream), margin 0, overflow-x hidden, line-height 1.6, font-size clamp(16px, 2.5vw, 18px). .section: min-height 100vh (on mobile), padding var(--section-padding), display flex, flex-direction column, align-items center, justify-content center, position relative, overflow hidden. Add .reveal class (opacity 0, transform translateY(30px)) and .reveal.active (opacity 1, transform translateY(0), transition var(--transition-smooth)). Add stagger delay utilities .stagger-1 through .stagger-5 with incremental transition-delay of 0.15s each.

Step 16 — CSS: Loader overlay. #loader: position fixed, inset 0, z-index 9999, background var(--color-cream), display flex, align-items center, justify-content center, transition opacity 0.5s. Add a CSS-only spinner or pulsing mandala animation using @keyframes. .loader-hidden: opacity 0, pointer-events none.

Step 17 — CSS: Music toggle button. .music-toggle: position fixed, bottom 1.5rem, right 1.5rem, z-index 100, width 48px, height 48px, border-radius 50%, background var(--color-gold), border none, cursor pointer, display flex, align-items center, justify-content center, box-shadow, transition. Use a CSS animation for pulsing bars (3 small spans inside the button that animate height). .music-toggle.paused spans stop animating.

Step 18 — CSS: Hero section styling. .hero: min-height 100vh, background linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-cream) 0%, var(--color-ivory) 50%, rgba(201,168,76,0.1) 100%), position relative. Add a ::before pseudo-element with a subtle repeating pattern (CSS-only using radial-gradient to create a faint mandala-dot pattern). .hero-subtitle: font-family var(--font-display), letter-spacing 0.3em, text-transform uppercase, color var(--color-gold), font-size clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1rem). h1: font-family var(--font-display), font-size clamp(2.5rem, 8vw, 5rem), color var(--color-maroon). .weds-text: font-family var(--font-body), font-style italic, color var(--color-gold), font-size 60% of parent. .hero-location: letter-spacing 0.2em, color var(--color-text-light).

Step 19 — CSS: Blessing section. .blessing: background var(--color-white), text-align center. .sanskrit: font-size clamp(1.2rem, 3vw, 1.6rem), color var(--color-gold). .mantra: font-style italic, color var(--color-text-light), line-height 1.8. .blessing-text: color var(--color-maroon), margin-top 2rem.

Step 20 — CSS: Couple section. .couple-cards container: display flex, flex-direction column on mobile, row on >= 768px, gap 2rem, align-items center. .couple-card: background var(--color-white), padding 2rem, border-radius 8px, border 1px solid rgba(201,168,76,0.3), box-shadow, text-align center, max-width 380px, width 100%. .couple-card h2: font-family var(--font-display), color var(--color-maroon), font-size clamp(1.8rem, 4vw, 2.5rem). .honorific: color var(--color-gold), font-style italic. .weds-divider: color var(--color-gold), font-family var(--font-display), font-style italic, font-size 1.5rem, with a decorative SVG ornament (small inline SVG flourish) above/below. On desktop, flex-direction row places cards side by side with weds-divider centered between them.

Step 21 — CSS: Our Story / Timeline section. .our-story: background var(--color-ivory). .timeline: position relative, max-width 700px, width 100%, padding-left 2rem on mobile. .timeline::before: content '', position absolute, left 0 (mobile) or left 50% (desktop), width 2px, background var(--color-gold), top 0, bottom 0. .timeline-item: position relative, margin-bottom 3rem, padding-left 2.5rem on mobile. .timeline-dot: position absolute, left -6px (mobile, relative to line), width 12px, height 12px, border-radius 50%, background var(--color-gold), border 2px solid var(--color-cream). .timeline-date: color var(--color-gold), font-weight 600, text-transform uppercase, letter-spacing 0.1em, font-size 0.85rem. .timeline-content h3: font-family var(--font-display), color var(--color-maroon). On desktop (>=768px): items alternate left/right using nth-child(odd/even), text-align alternates, padding switches sides. The connecting line centers at left: 50%.

Step 22 — CSS: Save the Date section. .save-the-date: text-align center, background var(--color-white). .scratch-cards: display flex, gap 1.5rem, justify-content center, flex-wrap wrap. canvas elements: width 120px, height 120px, border-radius 50% (clipped to heart shape via CSS clip-path or just circular), cursor pointer, touch-action none. Style the date-reveal container. .date-reveal: opacity 0, transform scale(0.95), transition. .date-reveal.visible: opacity 1, transform scale(1).

Step 23 — CSS: Countdown section. .countdown: background linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--color-ivory), var(--color-cream)). .countdown-boxes: display flex, gap clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2rem), justify-content center. .countdown-box: background var(--color-white), border 1px solid var(--color-gold), border-radius 8px, padding 1.5rem 1rem, min-width 70px, text-align center. .countdown-number: font-family var(--font-display), font-size clamp(2rem, 6vw, 3.5rem), color var(--color-maroon), display block. .countdown-label: font-size 0.75rem, text-transform uppercase, letter-spacing 0.15em, color var(--color-gold). Add @keyframes tick { 0% { transform: scale(1); } 50% { transform: scale(1.1); } 100% { transform: scale(1); } } for number changes.

Step 24 — CSS: Events section. .events: background var(--color-cream). .event-card: background var(--color-white), border-radius 12px, padding 2rem, border-left 4px solid var(--color-gold), margin-bottom 1.5rem, max-width 600px, width 100%, box-shadow. .event-card h3: font-family var(--font-display), color var(--color-maroon), font-size clamp(1.3rem, 3vw, 1.8rem). .event-card .event-time: color var(--color-gold), font-weight 600. .event-card .event-venue: font-style italic. .event-card .dress-code: display inline-flex, align-items center, gap 0.5rem, background rgba(201,168,76,0.1), padding 0.3rem 0.8rem, border-radius 4px. .directions-link: color var(--color-gold), text-decoration none, border-bottom 1px solid, transition. Stagger animation on cards via .stagger-1, .stagger-2, .stagger-3.

Step 25 — CSS: Families section. .families: background var(--color-white). Family columns: display grid, grid-template-columns 1fr on mobile, 1fr 1fr on >= 768px, gap 2rem. .family-card: text-align center, padding 1.5rem. .family-card h3: font-family var(--font-display), color var(--color-maroon). .family-role-group: margin-top 2rem. .family-role-group h4 (Darshanabhilashi, Swagatotsuk): color var(--color-gold), font-family var(--font-display), font-style italic. .family-closing: font-style italic, color var(--color-text-light), margin-top 2rem, text-align center.

Step 26 — CSS: Moments/Gallery section. .moments: background var(--color-ivory). .gallery-grid: display grid, grid-template-columns 1fr 1fr on mobile, repeat(4, 1fr) on desktop, gap 1rem, max-width 900px, width 100%. .gallery-item: border-radius 8px, overflow hidden, position relative. .gallery-placeholder: aspect-ratio 3/4, background linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-cream), rgba(201,168,76,0.15)), display flex, align-items center, justify-content center, border 1px solid rgba(201,168,76,0.3). Add a subtle camera/image icon via ::before pseudo-element (Unicode 📷 or SVG). figcaption: text-align center, padding 0.75rem, font-style italic, color var(--color-text-light). Hover effect: transform scale(1.03), box-shadow elevation, transition 0.3s.

Step 27 — CSS: Venue section. .venue: background var(--color-cream). .venue-grid: display grid, grid-template-columns 1fr on mobile, 1fr 1fr on >= 768px, gap 1.5rem, max-width 700px. .venue-item: display flex, gap 1rem, align-items flex-start, padding 1.5rem, background var(--color-white), border-radius 8px. .venue-icon: font-size 2rem, flex-shrink 0. .venue-item h3: font-family var(--font-display), color var(--color-maroon), margin-bottom 0.25rem. .venue-item p: color var(--color-text-light).

Step 28 — CSS: RSVP section. .rsvp: background var(--color-white), text-align center. .rsvp h2: font-family var(--font-display), color var(--color-maroon). .rsvp-button: display inline-block, background var(--color-gold), color var(--color-white), padding 1rem 2.5rem, border-radius 50px, text-decoration none, font-family var(--font-display), font-size 1.1rem, letter-spacing 0.05em, transition background 0.3s, box-shadow. .rsvp-button:hover: background var(--color-gold-light), transform translateY(-2px). .gift-note: font-style italic, color var(--color-text-light), margin-top 2rem.

Step 29 — CSS: Footer. .footer: min-height auto, padding 3rem 1rem, text-align center, background var(--color-cream), border-top 1px solid rgba(201,168,76,0.2). .footer p: color var(--color-text-light). .credits: font-size 0.8rem, opacity 0.6.

Step 30 — CSS: Decorative dividers between sections. Create a .section-divider class used between each section. The divider is a centered inline SVG ornament (a simple mandala-inspired or floral flourish pattern — a horizontal line with a small diamond/lotus shape in the center, done entirely with SVG path elements). Give it color var(--color-gold), max-width 200px, margin 0 auto. Place <div class='section-divider'> containing the inline SVG between each </section> and the next <section> in the HTML. Alternatively, use ::after pseudo-elements on .section to render a CSS-only ornamental divider (border with a centered dot or a gold gradient line with a circular ornament).

Step 31 — CSS: Responsive breakpoints. Add @media (min-width: 480px), (min-width: 768px), (min-width: 1024px). At 768px: couple cards go side-by-side, timeline items alternate left/right, families grid becomes 2 columns, venue grid 2 columns, gallery grid 4 columns. At 1024px: increase max-widths, slightly larger font scaling. Ensure all sections .section get min-height: auto on desktop where appropriate (events, families, venue don't need full-viewport). Verify touch-action: none is set on scratch card canvases for mobile.

findings: All 12 sections created with exact text content. The .reveal class is set to opacity:0/translateY(30px) — FEAT-002 JS must add .active via IntersectionObserver to make sections visible. Loader (#loader) stays visible until JS adds .loader-hidden class. Music toggle has 3 span bars with CSS animation; JS needs to toggle .paused class and handle audio playback. Scratch card canvases have data-label attributes and touch-action:none; JS must implement Canvas 2D scratch interaction. Countdown IDs: countdown-days, countdown-hours, countdown-minutes, countdown-seconds. Date reveal container needs .visible class added by JS after all 3 canvases are scratched. The @keyframes tick animation is defined for countdown number transitions. Stagger classes (stagger-1 through stagger-5) add incremental transition-delay on .reveal.active transitions.
